items.label: Wolfspeed Q4 FY2026 (08-19-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Technology: Gen 5 SiC MOSFET announced at PCIM (June 2026)

set.signal: Technology (CEO Robert Feurle): at PCIM this past June Wolfspeed announced its fifth-generation silicon carbide MOSFET technology; the company says Gen 5 MOSFETs 'deliver the best specific on state resistance in the industry while maintaining the excellent switching behavior introduced in our Gen 4 MOSFET', giving customers the option to maintain efficiency and reduce system size, or maintain system size and achieve greater power density. Beyond automotive (traction inverters, EV range, battery systems, charging), Gen 5 addresses AI data center power supplies, solid-state transformers and renewable energy conversion. Gen 5 'was developed and is running in our highly automated 200 mm facility in Mohawk Valley', which the CEO called a rapid, low-risk path from design into volume production. Wolfspeed also announced 10 kV MOSFET commercial readiness at PCIM, and a memorandum of understanding with GE Aerospace covers the supply of what Wolfspeed calls 'the industry's first commercially available 10 kV SiC MOSFET' plus co-development of standard high voltage power module formats for the industrial, aerospace and defense market.

items.reason: Verifier: the PCIM 'top innovation' acknowledgement is an award (skill section 2, not captured); 'best ... in the industry' and 'industry's first' attributed as the company's claims; speaker attributed.
items.evidence: Robert Feurle: Gen 5 MOSFET deliver the best specific on state resistance in the industry while maintaining the excellent switching behavior introduced in our Gen 4 MOSFET.
